🥗 When to plant lettuce in Nigeria

Quick answer: Plant lettuce in Nigeria from September to November and harvest from November to February. Best in the cool dry season; ready about 6–8 weeks after transplanting.

PlantSeptember to November
HarvestNovember to February
Grows inNorth-Central, North-West and South-West
TypeLeafy vegetables
JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec

■ plant   ■ harvest

About lettuce

Lettuce 'bolts' (runs to seed and turns bitter) in very hot weather.

How to plant lettuce well

Water in the morning and give light shade when it is hot.

Best in the cool dry season; ready about 6–8 weeks after transplanting.

Diseases and pests of lettuce

  • Downy mildewAvoid wetting leaves late in the day.
  • Bolting in heatPlant in the cool season or on the Plateau.

Best states for lettuce

Plateau · Kano · Kaduna · Lagos

Questions farmers ask

When is the best time to plant lettuce in Nigeria?

Plant lettuce in Nigeria from September to November and harvest from November to February. Best in the cool dry season; ready about 6–8 weeks after transplanting.

When is lettuce harvested in Nigeria?

Lettuce is usually harvested from November to February.

Which Nigerian states grow the most lettuce?

Plateau, Kano, Kaduna and Lagos are among the best-known lettuce states.

Can I grow lettuce in my part of Nigeria?

Lettuce grows best in the North-Central, North-West and South-West regions. In other regions, ask your ADP extension officer before planting.

What diseases attack lettuce and how do I prevent them?

Downy mildew: Avoid wetting leaves late in the day. Bolting in heat: Plant in the cool season or on the Plateau.
